Why go: your own speedboat to the Full Moon Party

A private speedboat takes the queues and the guesswork out of party night. Your group of up to 10 guests travels from Koh Samui straight to Haad Rin on Koh Phangan, at the departure time you choose between 18:00 and 23:00, and comes home at the return time you choose, from midnight to 06:00 the next morning. The price is per boat, so a full group of 10 pays 3,580 THB each for the return trip. That is more than a shared seat at 1,400 THB, but you skip the 01:00–06:00 queues for the shared return boats and travel only with your own group.

The Full Moon Party itself runs from dusk to after sunrise on Haad Rin Sunrise Beach, with several sound systems and fire shows along the sand. Party entry is about 200 THB per person, paid at the gate, and is not included (we don't sell entry tickets). The crossing from Samui takes about 30–45 minutes, depending on the sea and the pier.

Your boat takes you over and comes back for you at the agreed time; it does not wait at Haad Rin all night. Pick a return time you can keep, and stay reachable on WhatsApp. If you need a bigger or more comfortable boat, three-engine and VIP speedboats (also up to 10 guests) are available on request; message us for details.

Who this tour is for

  • Groups of 6–10 who want their own boat and their own times (3,580–5,970 THB per person).
  • Birthdays, stag and hen parties, and New Year's Eve groups who want their own boat.
  • Anyone who wants to leave the party at an exact time without queuing on the beach.

Who should choose another tour

  • One to four people: the shared Full Moon speedboat is far cheaper.
  • More than 10 guests: book a second boat or message us about a larger vessel.
  • Want a one-way transfer or a daytime crossing: see the private speedboat Samui to Koh Phangan.
  • Prefer a ticketed music festival: the Half Moon Festival package.

Stay safe on party night

  • Watch your drinks and never leave them unattended; drink spiking is a known risk at Haad Rin.
  • Don't swim after drinking, and never swim at night.
  • Stay away from drugs: Thai penalties are severe and police are present on party nights. See our drugs and alcohol law guide.
  • Agree a meeting point for the return, keep your phone charged and in a waterproof pouch, and wear the life jacket on the boat.
  • Carry cash for entry and drinks, closed shoes for the glass on the sand, and a copy of your passport rather than the original.

What to bring

  • Cash for party entry (about 200 THB per person) and drinks; ATM queues at Haad Rin are long on party night.
  • Your booking confirmation and the captain's contact number from it.
  • A waterproof phone pouch, a charged phone and a power bank.
  • Closed shoes or sturdy sandals, and a light layer for the ride home.
  • A copy of your passport, not the original.

Good to know

  • Book ahead: at least a week for most dates, and two to three weeks for 24 December and 31 December. Online booking for a party night closes at midnight Thai time the night before; for the day itself, message us on WhatsApp.
  • Sea and weather: boats run only in safe sea conditions. November to January brings the north-east monsoon. If we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or a new date.
  • Late returns: if your group is late for the agreed return time, call the number on your confirmation straight away so the captain knows.
  • Age: it is an adult event; under-18s should not travel to the party.

Pickup and meeting point

Hotel pickup and drop-off on Koh Samui are included for the group from the main areas: Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Maenam, Choeng Mon, Bang Rak and Plai Laem. Remote areas (Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao, Thong Krut and similar) cost 400 THB per person return. After booking we confirm the pier, your pickup time and the return meeting point at Haad Rin on WhatsApp.
